sign_off: That's the last sip. Same table, Monday morning.

big_pour.headline: Block built a voice AI that sounds eerily human
big_pour.teaser: a voice AI that sounds human
big_pour.summary: Jack Dorsey's company Block announced Dessa, an AI voice model trained "from scratch on nothing but human conversation." Block says it can run on a MacBook.
big_pour.why: AI voices that sound like real people are getting small enough to run on a laptop.

big_pour.headline: OpenAI stops training on the live internet
big_pour.summary: OpenAI says it will cut its newest models off from the internet while training, citing "significant risks."

big_pour.headline: Your Gmail may help Google target ads
big_pour.summary: Turning on Google's "Personal Intelligence" feature gives it more data for ad targeting.

office_blend.headline: Bayer's crop scientists can now just ask
office_blend.summary: Bayer Crop Science built a team of AI helpers that lets its breeders, analysts, and researchers ask questions in everyday language.

office_blend.headline: SAP certifications, now with AI roleplay
office_blend.summary: SAP professionals can renew their certifications by practising with AI-based roleplays.

still_roasting.summary: Claude Duet, Anthropic's new AI helper app, has a waitlist for paid users.
Nirva's $249 AI pendant, which listens only to you, ships by the end of the year.

quick_sips.summary: Canva launched its first AI image model, which plans a design before creating it.
OpenAI is working on a new $30B raise at a $1.25T valuation ahead of an IPO.
Meta delayed new business terms after publishers worried they'd let it scrape news sites for AI training.

stories.label: New tool
stories.headline: AWS Continuum hunts bugs in your repos
stories.summary: AWS made Continuum generally available. It finds and validates code vulnerabilities in your repositories. AWS says it fixes 89% of bugs, but The New Stack says there's a catch.

stories.label: Open standard
stories.headline: OpenAI gives away its LLM API spec
stories.summary: OpenAI is donating Open Responses, its specification for a common LLM API, to the open source Agentic AI Foundation.

concept.explanation: The code wrapped around an AI model that turns it into an agent: its tools, its memory, and the loop that runs it. It's in the news twice this week: Ramp built its own in six weeks, and five harnesses were put through the same memory test.

long_read.headline: What's the ROI of software engineers' spending on AI?
long_read.summary: AI spending is way up at most companies this year. The Pragmatic Engineer looks at data from 27 companies to ask whether it has changed shipping velocity and PR output.

word.definition: A small piece of text an AI reads, often part of a word.
word.analogy: Like coffee beans: AI grinds your sentence into little bits before it brews an answer.

keep_brewing.name: Elements of AI
keep_brewing.description: A free beginner course, no coding or maths needed. One short chapter with your morning coffee.

poll.question: Would you let an AI book your next trip?
